issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care request to realign Procedure and ProcedureRequest: subject/patient naming and Group support, performer actor naming with Organization support, notes as 0..* Annotation, and consistent resource ordering.
initial_application: Commit 27f73740e4afc943ade51df795872e6e5c3865ee explicitly mentioned #7633 and changed Procedure.patient to Procedure.subject, Procedure.performer.individual to Procedure.performer.actor, expanded Procedure.subject to Patient|Group, expanded Procedure.performer.actor to include Organization, and expanded ProcedureRequest.subject to Patient|Group. Later workflow-alignment commits including FHIR-10293 kept the notes shape as note 0..* Annotation.
additional_context: ProcedureRequest is no longer active in the current build. FHIR-13196 merged ReferralRequest with ProcedureRequest, FHIR-13867 renamed the merged resource to ServiceRequest, and source/fhir.ini records ProcedureRequest as merged into ServiceRequest. FHIR-26859 later broadened Procedure.subject beyond the original Patient|Group scope, so the current broader Procedure subject type list is intentional later evolution.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Procedure and ServiceRequest definitions already contain the relevant alignment: active subject elements allow Group, Procedure.performer.actor and ServiceRequest.performer allow Organization, and both note elements are 0..* Annotation. Active-source searches found no stale Procedure.patient, performer.individual, ProcedureRequest, or notes usage requiring cleanup.
